mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (indicating an easing monetary policy) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases the cost of capital and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 3 consecutive months over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining UNRATE and rising PAYEMS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances (i.e., Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1500 thousand units and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceed 700,000 million dollars, the economy enters a housing market recovery regime that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when HOUST > 1500 and RSAFS > 700000 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output and stronger corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when INDPRO is rising over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1400 thousand units, it signals a weakening housing market that reduces consumer confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when HOUST < 1400 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE below 4.5%), the tight labor market drives wage growth and corporate profit expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when UNRATE < 4.5 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5% and the federal funds rate remains stable (within 0.5% of its 12-month average), it signals persistent inflation that leads to anticipated monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 2.5 and FEDFUNDS within 0.5% of 12-month average
failure_condition: The joint signal of CPIAUCSL > 2.5 and FEDFUNDS within 0.5% of 12-month average fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances (i.e., Rank IC > -0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.
